name: Creditable Leaky Paywall Addon
author: eValue8 New Media Applications

sections.description:
The Creditable Leaky Paywall Addon is a free, easy-to-use plugin that integrates Creditable’s pay-per-article system into Leaky Paywall for WordPress.
Perfect for blogs and news sites, it lets you generate extra revenue by offering readers the option to pay for premium articles with universal credits (micropayments) instead of requiring registration or a full subscription.
Seamlessly monetize your content, earn a fixed fee per credit, and allow casual and occasional readers to pay without commitment.

Key features:

  • Add the creditable pay per article button into your leaky paywall.
  • Place the shortcode of the pay-per-article button at any desired position in your leaky paywall.
  • Allow your readers to pay for individual articles using Creditable’s universal credit system (micropayments).
  • Easily monetize your articles by charging readers to pay per post with universal credits (micropayments) to continue reading.
  • Set price and expiry for articles
  • Readers can register for Creditable and receive 10 free reading credits without leaving your site.
  • Readers can top up their credits balance by purchasing new credits bundles without leaving your site.

For more information about Creditable, please visit the Creditable website.
Get your free Creditable Partner Account at https://partner.creditable.news.
Through the partner management environment you can manage your websites, set prices and validity for your articles and view stats and earnings.

If you have any questions, don’t hesitate to contact us.
sections.installation:
To use the Creditable Leaky Paywall Addon, follow these steps:

  • Get your free Creditable Partner Account at https://partner.creditable.news. No signup costs are applicable.
  • Login to your dashboard at https://partner.creditable.news and add your WordPress website as a mediatitle (publication).
  • An apikey will be generated for each mediatitle you add.

Installation From your WordPress dashboard:

  1. First install the Creditable Paywall plugin if you haven’t already

– Navigate to ‘Plugins > Add New’
– Search for ‘creditable’ and install the Creditable Paywall plugin
– Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
– Submit the Creditable Api key of your mediatitle into the ‘Creditable Paywall Settings’

  1. Then install the Creditable Leaky Paywall addon

– Navigate to ‘Plugins > Add New’
– Search for ‘creditable’ and install the Creditable Leaky Paywall addon
– Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress

Once Installed:

  1. Go to Leaky Paywall > Settings in your WordPress dashboard
  2. Under the General tab, you will find the “Subscribe or Login Message”. Add the shortcode for the creditable button: [creditable-paywall-button]
  3. Under the General tab, you will find the “Upgrade Message”. Add the shortcode for the creditable button: [creditable-paywall-button]
  4. Use HTML to position the button the way you want. For instance you can type “

[creditable-paywall-button]” to align the button below a horizontal line.

To create a premium article:
– For best results add an image, topic, excerpt and tags to your article via the post section on the right.
– Your article will automatically appear in your Creditable partner account (if it meets your Leaky Paywall Settings for premium articles)
– Price (in credits) and expiry (in days) of the article are automatically set to default mediatitle settings.
– You can override default price and expiry by defining it per topic or even per article.
